coverage.const_writes: typed lvalues, const-address casts and simple local pointer aliases
coverage.cpp: qualified class-definition agreement across units and project headers (ODR, token-level; namespaces, enclosing classes and template specializations; unnamed namespaces unit-local), no forward declaration of a header-defined qualified class without that header, and no local extern "C" redeclaration of a symbol shared with another unit; declaration types and const writes unchecked; --allow-unchecked-cpp waives C++ only
not_covered: whole-program/heap alias analysis and pointer arithmetic
